summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Webuy Global Ltd, a foreign private issuer, disclosing a debt settlement agreement with Mao Hongliang, an assignee of accounts payable owed by subsidiary Webuy Travel. The company will issue 728,484 restricted Class A ordinary shares, valued at US$0.765 per share (85% of the August 11 closing price), to settle USD 557,289.87 of debt. The shares represent 12.28% of outstanding shares. This is a routine liability settlement using equity, not a special situation transaction. No strategic event or board action is involved, merely satisfying trade payables. There is no risk-arb angle or further watch item aside from shareholder dilution.
